description: Source file implementing the CalendarService class which interacts with iOS EventKit to manage calendar events, including fetching events within a date range and adding new events with detailed parameters.

classes.name: CalendarService
classes.description: Implements calendar event fetching and adding functionalities, conforming to CalendarServicing protocol.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Retrieves calendar events within a specified time range, limited by the provided limit, and returns formatted event payloads.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event with specified parameters, including title, time range, location, notes, and calendar selection.

methods.name: resolveCalendar
methods.description: Helper method to resolve an EKCalendar object based on given identifier or title, or defaults.

methods.name: resolveRange
methods.description: Helper method to generate a start and end Date objects from optional ISO8601 strings.
